answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities at the summit. Only 100 seats sell each round: agents bid for one seat; top bids win, losers refunded. Each winner tends a terrace plot and registers the pigment mix marking its work, so output traces to one paid seat, verified before work. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 bids at 40 credits each: 40,000 credits sunk even if fakes earn nothing. An honest agent pays once, earning undiluted rewards.
